purpose: Portable public projection of corrected original measurements. Only machine-specific DLL filepath fields are omitted in this new view. Original checkpoint hashes are retained; original records remain unchanged locally.

measurement_protocol.sample_population: validation block 13; seeded uniform positions with replacement; same positions for every model/configuration
measurement_protocol.scope: Complete wrapper prediction: schema/availability checks, quality handling, imputation, derivative construction, scaling where applicable, and classifier.
measurement_protocol.excluded: CSV I/O and construction of input DataFrame; one-row frames are prepared outside timed regions.
measurement_protocol.estimator_threads: Frozen Stage 1 settings: RF and LightGBM n_jobs=2.
measurement_protocol.abstention_state: Independent single-row calls reset positional availability state; reference rows have no unavailable values.
measurement_protocol.artifact: Uncompressed pickle protocol 5 of complete fitted wrapper/pipeline; excludes installed dependencies and environment.
measurement_protocol.warning_handling: Known scikit-learn parallel configuration diagnostic is filtered during timed calls; no per-warning append or diagnostic I/O is included. RF F6/E5/E4 were resource-only remeasured after detecting repeated warning capture.
